title: 第23章 拉个垫背的第24章 这真是剑匣
slug: 重生后长公主只想种田
content_zh:
;;
“刚做了个梦，有个绝世大美男有难，我去救一下。”
沈青鱼说完衣服也穿好了，立马出了门。
等云珏胡乱披好衣服，坐轮椅出来看时，连个人影都没见着。
“沈，青，鱼。”云珏捏紧了拳头。
阿嚏！
沈青鱼打了个喷嚏，感觉有人在背后蛐蛐自己，头皮有一点麻麻的。
等回过神来时，人已经到了撒袋沟。
啪叽！
原本有拇指粗的小龙脉，此时缩减成蚯蚓大小，乍一眼看着还真以为是条金色蚯蚓。
“你不行啊！”沈青鱼啧啧道。
【尊上，咱能不皮了吗？那头虎妖要出来了。】
“噢。”
沈青鱼将它捡起放到自己的手腕上，这才抬头朝镇魔军看去。
这群镇魔军修为大多在玄品，有十名小将是地品，大皇子是天品，此时他们正结阵对付宗师境熊妖。
看着吃力了些，但也不是没有胜算。
当然这前提是没有捣乱的。
沈青鱼视线落在这片山坳的另一头，有一道强大气息正在蛰伏，又或者说是在看好戏等待时机。
“这气息，是大宗师境中期，我才宗师巅峰。”
【这……尊上你行不行？】

“行不行的，得试过才知道。”
沈青鱼从包袱里拿出一个黑色长方型物件，体内真气运转，迅速朝虎妖所在山窝窝潜移去。
【这东西咋看着有点眼熟？】
小龙脉支着脑袋，盯着沈青鱼手上的黑色长方型物件，直到它看到上面那道剑纹，才震惊地瞪大眼睛。
【这这这，这咋跟你躺着的那口棺材那么像？】
“眼瞎吗？这是剑匣。”
小龙脉：……
行了，真相了。
还真是它家尊上躺的那口棺材。
小龙脉有点好奇，此时的棺材……剑匣里装的，会是一把什么样的剑。
却见沈青鱼悄然靠近那正猥琐蹲在那儿、流着哈喇子看好戏的虎妖身后，抄起迅速放大的剑匣就砸了下去。
砰！

"I just had a dream. There was a beautiful man in trouble. I went to save him."
After Shen Qingyu finished speaking, she put on her clothes and went out immediately.
When Yun Jue put on her clothes and came out in a wheelchair, she didn't even see anyone.
"Shen, Qing, Yu." Yun Jue clenched her fists.
Ah sneeze!
Shen Qingyu sneezed, feeling like someone was cricketing him behind his back, and his scalp felt a little numb.
When he came back to his senses, he had already arrived at Sadaogou.
Bang!
The small dragon vein, which was originally about the thickness of a thumb, has now shrunk to the size of an earthworm. At first glance, I really thought it was a golden earthworm.
"You can't do it!" Shen Qingyu tutted.
[Your Majesty, can we lose our skin? That tiger monster is coming out. 】
"Oh."
Shen Qingyu picked it up and put it on his wrist, then raised his head and looked at the Demon Suppressing Army.
Most of this group of demon-suppressing troops are at the Xuan level. There are ten young generals who are at the Earth level and the eldest prince is at the Heaven level. At this time, they are forming a formation to deal with the Grandmaster level bear monster.
It looks a bit difficult, but it’s not without a chance of winning.
Of course, this premise is that there is no trouble.
Shen Qingyu's eyes fell on the other side of the mountain. There was a powerful aura dormant, or it could be said that he was watching a good show and waiting for the opportunity.
"This aura is from the middle stage of the Grand Master Realm, and I am at the peak of the Grand Master Realm."
[This... can you do this, Your Majesty? 】
"You have to try it to know whether it works or not."
Shen Qingyu took out a black rectangular object from his bag, and with his true energy circulating in his body, he quickly moved toward the mountain den where the tiger demon was.
[Why does this thing look familiar? 】
Xiao Longmai propped his head up and stared at the black rectangular object in Shen Qingyu's hand. It wasn't until he saw the sword pattern on it that his eyes widened in shock.
[This, this, this, how does this look so similar to the coffin you are lying on? 】
"Are you blind? This is the sword box."
Xiaolongmai:......
Okay, here’s the truth.
It was really the coffin in which his master lay.
Xiaolongmai was a little curious as to what kind of sword the coffin at this time...the sword box contained.
But she saw Shen Qingyu quietly approaching behind the tiger demon who was squatting there obscenely and watching the show, picked up the rapidly enlarged sword box and smashed it down.
Bang!
